name: maximilian-universal-workflow
description: Universal Codex-native phase workflow harness for git repository workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Outcome-first repo workflow guidance for Codex
interface.longDescription: Outcome-first Codex workflow guidance for git repository workspaces with phase-state handoffs, bounded explorer and worker fanout, git worktree isolation, default native goal-backed execution, proportional evidence artifacts, and MultiAgentV2 coordination lanes.
defaultPrompt: Complete the repo task with branch, instruction, safety, goal, and verification boundaries.
Use goal-backed planning; create goals only at gates; route through worktrees, execution, verification, review, or handoff.
Preserve native goal state and keep subagents and HTML evidence proportional to task risk.
